class.agency: Statewide classified service (Office of Financial Management State HR)
class.mqParaphrase: Desirable: bachelor's in natural science plus 3 years research; master's = 2 years; Ph.D. = all.

licensesRequired.credential: Washington geologist / engineering geologist / hydrogeologist licence

competencyTargets.label: Analyze remotely sensed data to map and monitor environmental conditions
Conduct spatial analysis and modelling of environmental data
Protect sensitive ecological, cultural and personal information in data products
Conduct reproducible, auditable environmental analysis, including AI-assisted code
Evaluate model fitness-for-purpose and validate against independent evidence
Quantify and communicate uncertainty for environmental decisions
Validate AI-generated work products before professional use
Ground-truth remote-sensed, modelled and AI-generated outputs in the field
Design maps and visualizations that communicate environmental data and uncertainty
Build and validate automated detection and classification models for environmental observations
Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work
Steward and publish environmental data for reuse
Design and manage environmental databases
Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work

topTasks.statement: Interpret satellite and aerial imagery to detect changes in vegetation, soil or water condition across a management area between two dates.
Classify preprocessed multispectral imagery into land-cover types using training data whose collection method and date are documented.
Preprocess imagery for analysis by correcting geometry, radiometry and cloud or shadow contamination, documenting each step and its parameters.
Assess the accuracy of a remotely sensed map against independent field reference data, reporting error by class and condition.
Run spatial queries and overlays for an environmental assessment, checking that all layers share a coordinate reference system and compatible scales.
Analyze terrain, habitat connectivity or resource distribution for a planning question, stating the data, projection and accuracy limits that bound the answer.
Build a predictive spatial model for a conservation planning question, documenting its inputs, assumptions and validation against independent locations.
Design a map for a stated audience and decision, choosing scale, extent, symbology and colour that the audience reads correctly.
Check whether a map product shares training data with the reference used to validate it, choosing an independent reference when it does.
Maintain spatial layers of land use, vegetation and infrastructure with topology rules, attribute standards and update dates recorded.
Depict the uncertainty of a mapped or charted estimate with an encoding that intended users read correctly in a comprehension check.
Produce maps for reports, briefings and field crews at the scale, extent and legibility each use requires.

Measure water quality and survey aquatic communities in the field

Evaluate model fitness-for-purpose and validate against independent evidence

topTasks.statement: Prepare a drought contingency plan with triggers, stages and response actions tied to supply indicators
Run an aquifer test on a supply well or wellfield to estimate transmissivity and storage from drawdown and recovery data
Delineate a wellhead or source-water protection area from hydrogeologic data and time-of-travel criteria
Simulate ecosystem response to alternative land-use and climate scenarios, documenting scenario assumptions and the sensitivity of results to each.
Forecast water demand and supply under drought and climate scenarios for a utility or basin plan, stating assumptions and uncertainty
Compare conjunctive-use, reuse and storage options by yield, cost and reliability for an integrated resource plan
Review a well construction or injection well application against construction and protection standards before approval
Build a predictive model of fire risk, pest outbreak or water availability, validating it on years or areas withheld from fitting.
Forecast resource management needs from a validated predictive model, stating the horizon and interval for each estimate.
Survey channel cross-sections, longitudinal profile and substrate at a reach following the geomorphic assessment protocol
Identify bankfull indicators and channel evolution stage at a reach from field evidence
Collect grab water samples at locations and depths that represent the condition of interest, recording flow and site conditions at collection
